title: Skeleton DJ and Cowboy
description: A bearded cowboy in a brown hat and bandolier stands in the foreground, tipping his hat while holding a sword. Beside him, a skeleton wearing headphones and a red robe sits against a large tree, operating a DJ turntable as a large blue dragon with autumn leaves flies overhead under a starry night sky.
